title: runtime: the action activation door drops the declaration's ambiguity refusal, so two packages' same-named global action answers 404 'has no declaration' instead of 409 naming the holders (ADR-0150)
body:
domain:server#2 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CaP1iy4RSEQbW6177G

Filing category: ① product defect with a named location (out-of-scope finding, class a, of #32517's os-dev report 6820789989, measured on `main` and on PR #32687's head `cf96064ea`). Part of #31527 (ADR-0150) · Refs #32517

## 维护者速读

- 改什么：两个包各声明一个同名、不挂对象的 action 时，激活门 `POST /actions/_activation/global/:action` 应像执行门一样答 409 并点名两个持有者，而不是 404「has no declaration」。
- 为什么：声明解析其实给出了拒绝（歧义），激活门却丢掉 `declaration.refusal`，只看 `declaration.action` 为空就答「没有声明」；把歧义报成不存在，违反专题红线「歧义要报告、不许猜」。
- 风险：第一方 0 处（两个包同名全局 action）；404 → 409，需声明 FROM → TO（收窄类）。
- 先看：`packages/runtime/src/domains/actions.ts` 第 3 步（约 :218-244）：`resolveRouteActionDeclaration` 之后只判 `degraded` 与 `!declaration.action`。
- 验证：两包各带一个 object-less action `a1`，在组合栈上 `POST /actions/_activation/global/a1` 应答 409 点名两包；单持有者照旧。
- 需要你做的：无，归专题席派发。

## What happens

On the composed stack (main too), two packages' object-less action of one name: the bare execution door answers `409` naming the holders, but the activation door answers `404 "has no declaration — there is nothing to switch"`. `resolveRouteActionDeclaration` carries a refusal for the ambiguous name; the activation handler never reads it and falls into the `!declaration.action` branch.

## Do

1. When the declaration reading carries a refusal, the activation door answers it (status and holders as the execution door does) before the "no declaration" branch. Both `enabled: true` and `false`.
2. Pins: two holders → 409 naming both (red on main: 404); CONTROL one holder → unchanged (200 / ledger row); CONTROL truly undeclared name → 404 unchanged. Ablate once.
3. Declare the FROM → TO (`404 has no declaration` → `409` naming holders). Metadata-protocol per the #32649 gate.

Reader who acts: the server seat the epic seat routes it to. Epic red-line read before landing. Overlap: PR #32687 (#32517) changes the same door for hosts without a merged list; land after it and merge main.
Blocked-by: #32517
Grade: p2 (first-party reach 0).
